events.body:
Senja’s testimonial collection software lets you request student videos for cohort marketing.

Set a form question to **Video**, and students must record or upload a video. Want to give them a choice? Choose **Video and text**. They can submit either format for that question, but not both.

For a question focused on course outcomes, try: “What did you put into practice from the course, and what happened?”

Once a student submits a video, you can reuse it in Senja widgets, emails and remix videos. A recording collected from one cohort can become material for marketing the next.

Signup starts with an account: verify your email, add your name and website, then choose Free as your starting plan. From there, evaluate the request workflow and check plan availability for the reuse features you need.

Senja is testimonial collection software with course form templates, individual or bulk invitations, and an option to offer rewards alongside your request.

If a student submits a video, Free includes SD video export for reuse in cohort marketing.

Signup starts with email verification, followed by your name, website and plan choice. Choose Free to begin evaluating the form.
